kind.description: What the gate failure IS. 'deterministic_fix' = a formatter/codegen gate the repo's own tool fixes in place; 'code_fix' = a real code defect needing a driver fix-up; 'flaky' = a transient test failure to retry; 'env' = toolchain/infrastructure failure (missing binary, OOM); 'rate_limit' = provider/API rate limit; 'unknown' = cannot be classified, escalate.

confidence.description: How confident you are in the classification, 0..1. Be honest — a low confidence on 'unknown' is the correct answer when the log is genuinely ambiguous.

suggested.description: For a 'deterministic_fix' only: the kind of command that would remediate it, chosen from the repo's Known commands. Null for every other kind, or when no Known command matches.

evidence.description: The single most diagnostic line (or short fragment) from the failure log that you keyed your classification on, so the routing/audit trail shows WHY.
